(i) N=2 invariance of the expansion forms implies that the truncation to gauged N=2 is consistent; (ii) the existence of de-Sitter vacua is excluded in the tree level truncation; (iii) at one loop order, the existence of deSitter vacua depends on the existence of a solution of the BPS equations for the N=1 truncation, which is not known.
1) the N = 1 and N = 2 solutions are related to each other by a duality, 2) the duality is a symmetry of the full stringy effective action and 3) it is not broken by quantum corrections.
